name: William Hornbuckle
current_role: CEO & President, MGM Resorts International; director, GBank Financial Holdings
profile: Bill Hornbuckle is a Las Vegas hospitality veteran who joined MGM in 1998, rose through COO and CMO roles, and became MGM Resorts CEO in 2020. His contract runs through 2028, after which he is slated to advise on MGM's ~$9B Osaka integrated resort. He also co-chairs MGM China and chairs the U.S. Travel Association.
interesting_fact: He helped bring the Raiders and the WNBA Aces to Las Vegas and served as president of T-Mobile Arena; he co-founded GBank (formerly Bank of George).
deep_cut_fact: Born on a U.S. Air Force base in Japan and raised in Connecticut, he found hospitality bartending at 18, drove cross-country to UNLV's hotel school, and started as a room-service attendant and busboy at the Jockey Club; he was on the opening team of The Mirage.
notes: Japan (Osaka) angle and energy/infrastructure of mega-resorts could be a podcast hook. Route via MGM corporate communications.

name: Denise C Johnson
current_role: Group President, Resource Industries, Caterpillar Inc. (retiring Feb 1, 2027; advisory role during transition)
profile: Denise Johnson is a Michigan State mechanical engineer and MIT LGO alumna who spent two decades at GM (product development, labor relations VP, head of GM Brazil) before joining Caterpillar in 2011. She has led Caterpillar's mining equipment group, Resource Industries, since 2016, returning it to profitability and making Cat a leader in mining autonomy. Caterpillar announced in Oct 2026 that she will retire Feb 1, 2027.
interesting_fact: She was the first woman in Caterpillar's history to lead one of its business groups, and oversaw the scale-up of Cat's autonomous mining truck fleet.
deep_cut_fact: Facing her first union negotiation as GM's labor-relations VP after the 2009 bankruptcy, she pulled out her old MIT LGO negotiations-class notes, including her written list of BATNAs.
notes: Retiring Feb 2027 (successor Derrick York from Nov 1, 2026) per Caterpillar release https://www.caterpillar.com/en/news/corporate-press-releases/h/caterpillar-announces-leadership-transition-in-resource-industries.html. Mining electrification/autonomy is a strong energy-podcast angle; post-retirement she may be more available. Route via Caterpillar corporate communications.
